[message_id=687101 author=NatSwamin first=True]
Hi,
All the answers in the column are rounded off just to two place alone in training. This results in rounding off errors when the prompt gets solved. Is there a tolerance built in to accept the answers if so what is it? I am wondering what needs to be consistent treatment in train and test dataset. can the challenge organiser clarify?
Many Thanks
Nat!

[message_id=3433851 author=MD Mushfirat Mohaimin first=False]
For numerical values, the tolerance is 1%.
This is the evaluation code: https://www.kaggle.com/code/metric/nvidia-nemotron-metric

[message_id=3433931 author=NatSwamin first=False]
Hi ,
Thanks for your response.
Where is this 0.01 tolerance is mentioned? Not all training examples confirm to this tolerance either? Does this mean train dataset is not validated for confirmance?
Many Thanks
Nat!

[message_id=3433962 author=CPMP first=False]
It is in the notebook you were pointed to.
